import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
    b = list(map(int, input[n+1:2*n+1]))

    original_sum = sum(abs(ai - bi) for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
    if n == 1:
        print(original_sum)
        return

    min_diff = float('inf')
    best_swap_value = 0

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            diff = abs(a[i] - b[j]) + abs(a[j] - b[i]) - abs(a[i] - b[i]) - abs(a[j] - b[j])
            if diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = diff
                best_swap_value = diff

    print(original_sum + best_swap_value)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
